parts: adv::Although she already owned a laptop, ||subj::Maya||pred:: bought a notebook so that she could sketch ideas by hand.
translation: 虽然玛雅已经有一台笔记本电脑，她还是买了一本笔记本，以便能用手画出想法。
analysis: Although 引出让步背景，主句是 Maya bought a notebook；so that 从句解释购买目的。a laptop 与 a notebook 都是不特指的单数可数名词。

parts: adv::When the bridge was damaged by the storm, ||subj::the team||pred:: had to abandon the route they had planned for months.
translation: 桥梁被暴风雨损坏后，团队不得不放弃筹划了数月的路线。
analysis: When 从句说明被迫改道的背景；主干是 the team had to abandon the route。they had planned for months 是省略关系代词的定语从句，修饰 route。

parts: adv::Before the doors closed, ||subj::a member of staff||pred:: checked that every passenger was safely aboard.
translation: 车门关闭之前，一名工作人员确认每位乘客都已安全上车。
analysis: Before 从句给出时间；checked 后的 that 从句是检查内容。aboard 在从句中作表语的一部分，说明乘客已在交通工具内。

parts: adv::Although some parents opposed the change, ||subj::the school||pred:: decided to abolish a rule that no longer served a useful purpose.
translation: 尽管一些家长反对变动，学校仍决定废除一条已无实际作用的规定。
analysis: 主干是 the school decided to abolish a rule。that 从句修饰 rule，说明废除原因；Although 引出与最终决定相反的意见。

parts: adv::Since the abolition of the entrance fee, ||subj::the museum||pred:: has welcomed more families who had previously found a visit too expensive.
translation: 自从取消门票收费，这家博物馆接待了更多原先觉得参观费用过高的家庭。
analysis: Since 后面是名词短语，不是从句；主句用现在完成时说明变化持续至今。who 从句修饰 families，had found 表示在变化之前的感受。

parts: adv::When students are uncertain about the instructions, ||subj::teachers||pred:: should give them time to ask questions before the task begins.
translation: 学生对要求不确定时，教师应在任务开始前留出提问时间。
analysis: 主干是 teachers should give them time。about 接在 uncertain 后，指出不确定的内容；to ask questions 说明 time 的用途。

parts: adv::Although the price was above our original budget, ||subj::we||pred:: chose the model that would be cheaper to repair.
translation: 尽管价格超过原定预算，我们还是选了维修费用更低的那一款。
analysis: above 表超过预算这一数额；主句的宾语是 the model，that 从句给出选择它的理由。would be cheaper 描写预计的维修成本。

parts: adv::Before she went abroad to study, ||subj::Lina||pred:: had never lived in a place where she could not speak the local language.
translation: 出国学习之前，莉娜从未住过不会讲当地语言的地方。
analysis: 主干用过去完成时 had never lived，指早于 went abroad 的经历；where 从句修饰 place。abroad 前不需要介词 to。

parts: adv::In the absence of reliable data, ||subj::the researchers||pred:: were careful not to claim that the treatment had worked.
translation: 缺乏可靠数据时，研究人员谨慎地避免声称该处理方法有效。
analysis: 句首 in the absence of 是介词短语，说明证据条件；not 放在 to claim 前是否定不定式。that 从句是 claim 的内容。

parts: adv::Because several members were absent from the meeting, ||subj::the committee||pred:: postponed the decision until everyone could take part.
translation: 由于几位成员未出席会议，委员会把决定推迟到所有人都能参与时再作出。
analysis: Because 引出原因，主干是 the committee postponed the decision。absent from 表示未出席；until 从句给出推迟的时间终点。

parts: adv::While the experiment required absolute silence, ||subj::the room||pred:: was close to a road where heavy traffic continued all day.
translation: 实验要求绝对安静，房间却临近一条全天都有繁忙车流的道路。
analysis: While 在这里表达两种情况的对照，不能只按同时发生来译。where 从句修饰 road；absolute 修饰 silence，强调完全安静。

parts: adv::Although the ground absorbed much of the rain, ||subj::water||pred:: still collected in the streets that lay below the river bank.
translation: 尽管土地吸收了大量雨水，低于河岸的街道上仍积起了水。
analysis: 主干是 water still collected in the streets。absorbed 是 absorb 的过去式；that 从句修饰 streets，说明哪些街道易积水。

parts: adv::Because different surfaces vary in their absorption of heat, ||subj::the colour of a roof||pred:: can influence how warm a building becomes.
translation: 由于不同表面对热量的吸收有差异，屋顶颜色会影响建筑物变得多热。
analysis: Because 从句解释原因；how warm a building becomes 是 influence 的宾语从句。absorption of heat 把吸热动作名词化。

parts: adv::Before deciding whether the study was relevant, ||subj::the students||pred:: read its abstract and noted the questions the researchers had asked.
translation: 判断研究是否相关之前，学生先读了摘要，并记下研究人员提出的问题。
analysis: Before 后接动名词结构，隐含主语是 students。read 与 noted 并列作谓语；the researchers had asked 是省略关系代词的定语从句，修饰 questions。

parts: adv::Despite an abundance of online information, ||subj::many learners||pred:: still need help deciding which sources they can trust.
translation: 尽管网上信息丰富，许多学习者仍需有人帮助判断哪些来源可信。
analysis: Despite 后接名词短语；主干是 many learners still need help。deciding 说明需要帮助的事，which sources 从句是 deciding 的宾语。

parts: adv::Although sunlight is abundant in the region, ||subj::households||pred:: cannot benefit from solar power unless suitable equipment is affordable.
translation: 虽然该地区阳光充足，如果合适的设备价格无法承受，家庭仍不能从太阳能中受益。
analysis: Although 引出有利条件，unless 再给出限制条件；主干是 households cannot benefit。abundant 作表语，描述 sunlight 的充足程度。

parts: adv::If companies abuse the information that customers provide, ||subj::those customers||pred:: may become unwilling to share even basic details in the future.
translation: 如果企业滥用客户提供的信息，这些客户以后可能连基本资料都不愿分享。
analysis: If 从句中，that customers provide 修饰 information；主句是 customers may become unwilling。abuse 的宾语是 information，表示滥用。

parts: adv::After several abusive messages appeared on the forum, ||subj::the moderators||pred:: introduced a rule requiring members to discuss ideas without attacking people.
translation: 论坛出现几条辱骂性消息后，管理员制定了一条规则，要求成员讨论观点时不得攻击他人。
analysis: 主干是 the moderators introduced a rule。requiring 短语后置修饰 rule；without attacking people 说明讨论时应避免的行为。abusive 修饰 messages。

parts: adv::Although the book was written for an academic audience, ||subj::its author||pred:: used examples that readers outside the field could understand.
translation: 尽管这本书面向学术读者，作者仍采用了领域外的读者也能理解的例子。
analysis: was written 是被动语态，for 短语说明受众。that 从句修饰 examples，could understand 的宾语由关系代词 that 承担。

parts: adv::After she was elected an academician, ||subj::the researcher||pred:: continued teaching the introductory course that had first drawn her to education.
translation: 当选院士后，这位研究者仍继续教授最初让她对教育产生兴趣的那门入门课程。
analysis: was elected an academician 表当选某身份。主干是 the researcher continued teaching the course；that 从句修饰 course，had drawn 说明更早的经历。

parts: adv::Although the academy had limited funds, ||subj::it||pred:: offered evening classes to adults who could not study during the day.
translation: 虽然这所学校经费有限，它仍向白天无法上课的成人提供夜间课程。
analysis: it 指 academy；主干是 it offered evening classes。who 从句修饰 adults，说明服务对象。academy 在这里指教学机构。

parts: adv::If the new system allows people to share results quickly, ||subj::it||pred:: may accelerate research without requiring a larger team.
translation: 如果新系统让人们迅速共享结果，它可能在不扩大团队的情况下加快研究进展。
analysis: If 从句中 allows 后接 people to share，构成复合宾语；主句 it 指 new system。without requiring 表示未增加的条件。

parts: adv::Because the passengers were standing, ||subj::the bus's sudden acceleration||pred:: caused several of them to lose their balance.
translation: 由于乘客站着，公交车突然加速使其中几人失去了平衡。
analysis: 主语是完整的名词短语 the bus's sudden acceleration，谓语是 caused。cause sb. to do 表示使某人发生某动作；them 指 passengers。

parts: adv::Although his accent was unfamiliar to the listeners, ||subj::he||pred:: spoke slowly enough for everyone to follow the main points.
translation: 虽然听众不熟悉他的口音，他讲得足够慢，大家都能跟上要点。
analysis: 主干是 he spoke slowly enough；enough 后的 for everyone to follow 说明达到的程度。unfamiliar to 指听众感到陌生。

parts: adv::Before you accept an offer of employment, ||subj::you||pred:: should check whether the working hours are clearly stated in the contract.
translation: 接受录用之前，你应检查合同是否明确写出了工作时间。
analysis: whether 从句是 check 的宾语，内部 are stated 是被动语态。accept an offer 表示同意接受，区别于仅仅收到。

parts: adv::Although both sides wanted an agreement, ||subj::they||pred:: struggled to find a solution that was acceptable to everyone affected.
translation: 虽然双方都希望达成协议，他们却很难找到一个所有受影响者都能接受的解决办法。
analysis: that 从句修饰 solution；affected 是过去分词，后置修饰 everyone。acceptable to 指对哪些人而言可以接受。

parts: adv::As the evidence became stronger, ||subj::the idea||pred:: gained wider acceptance among scientists who had initially questioned it.
translation: 随着证据越来越有力，这一观点在最初质疑它的科学家中获得了更广泛的认可。
analysis: As 表示随之变化；主干是 the idea gained wider acceptance。who 从句修饰 scientists，it 指 the idea。

parts: adv::Unless students have access to a reliable internet connection, ||subj::courses that depend entirely on video calls||pred:: may exclude some of the people they are intended to help.
translation: 如果学生无法使用稳定的网络，完全依赖视频通话的课程可能会把部分原本要帮助的人排除在外。
analysis: 主语是 courses，that 从句修饰它；they are intended to help 修饰 people，they 指 courses。have access to 指能够使用。

parts: adv::By providing captions and written summaries, ||subj::the team||pred:: made the lectures accessible to people who found the recordings difficult to follow.
translation: 团队提供字幕和文字摘要，使难以跟上录音内容的人也能理解这些讲座。
analysis: By 后接动名词说明手段；made the lectures accessible 是使役结构，accessible 作宾语补足语。who 从句修饰 people。

parts: adv::After the accident, ||subj::engineers||pred:: examined the crossing to find out why drivers had failed to see approaching trains.
translation: 事故发生后，工程师检查了道口，查明司机为何未能看见驶近的火车。
analysis: 主干是 engineers examined the crossing；to find out 表目的，why 从句是 find out 的宾语。had failed 表事故前已经发生的失误。

parts: adv::Although the discovery was accidental, ||subj::the scientist||pred:: recognised its importance because she had spent years studying similar materials.
translation: 虽然发现纯属偶然，这位科学家仍识别出了它的重要性，因为她多年一直在研究类似材料。
analysis: Although 和 because 分别给出让步与原因；主干是 the scientist recognised its importance。accidental 描述发现的方式，不否定研究积累。

parts: adv::When the number of applicants doubled, ||subj::the organisers||pred:: moved the event to a hall that could accommodate everyone comfortably.
translation: 申请人数翻倍后，组织者把活动移到了一间能让所有人舒适入座的礼堂。
analysis: 主干是 the organisers moved the event；that 从句修饰 hall。accommodate 的宾语 everyone 表明这里是容纳人的意思。

parts: adv::Because affordable accommodation was difficult to find, ||subj::many students||pred:: chose to live farther from the campus than they had originally planned.
translation: 由于难以找到价格可承受的住处，许多学生选择住得比原先计划离校园更远。
analysis: 主干是 many students chose to live；farther ... than 作距离比较。accommodation 在这里作不可数名词，表示住宿。

parts: adv::Since her father could not travel alone, ||subj::she||pred:: arranged for a relative to accompany him to the appointment.
translation: 因为父亲无法独自出行，她安排了一位亲属陪他去赴约。
analysis: Since 表原因；arranged for a relative to accompany 是安排某人做某事。him 指 father，accompany 直接接 him，不添 with。

parts: adv::Although each volunteer had only an hour to spare, ||subj::the group||pred:: managed to accomplish work that would have taken one person several days.
translation: 虽然每名志愿者只能抽出一小时，大家仍设法完成了一个人要花好几天才能完成的工作。
analysis: 主干是 the group managed to accomplish work。that 从句修饰 work；would have taken 表达假设由一个人完成时所需的时间。

parts: adv::For students who had never spoken in public before, ||subj::finishing the presentation||pred:: was an accomplishment worth celebrating.
translation: 对从未公开演讲过的学生来说，完成这次展示是一项值得庆祝的成就。
analysis: 主语是动名词短语 finishing the presentation。who 从句修饰 students；worth celebrating 后置说明 accomplishment 值得庆祝。

parts: adv::Although the two organisations had different priorities, ||subj::they||pred:: reached an accord on how the shared space should be used.
translation: 尽管两个组织的优先事项不同，它们仍就如何使用公共空间达成了协议。
analysis: 主干是 they reached an accord；on 后的 how 从句给出协议内容，内部 should be used 是被动语态。

parts: adv::In accordance with the policy announced last month, ||subj::all applications||pred:: must be assessed by at least two independent reviewers.
translation: 按照上个月公布的政策，所有申请必须由至少两名独立评审者评估。
analysis: announced last month 是过去分词短语，修饰 policy；主干是 all applications must be assessed。in accordance with 引出遵循的规定。

parts: adv::When the survey showed that most users preferred a simpler design, ||subj::the developers||pred:: adjusted the interface accordingly rather than adding more features.
translation: 调查显示多数用户更喜欢简洁设计后，开发人员相应调整了界面，没有继续增加功能。
analysis: When 从句内含 showed 的 that 宾语从句；accordingly 指依据调查结果作出调整。rather than adding 表示舍弃的做法。

parts: adv::Although the witness gave a detailed account of the event, ||subj::the investigators||pred:: still needed evidence that could confirm the sequence of actions.
translation: 尽管目击者详细叙述了事件，调查人员仍需要能够证实动作先后顺序的证据。
analysis: account of the event 表事件叙述；主干是 investigators still needed evidence。that 从句修饰 evidence，说明需要什么样的证据。

parts: adv::If decisions are made without a written record, ||subj::it||pred:: becomes harder to maintain accountability when something goes wrong.
translation: 如果作出决定时没有书面记录，一旦出问题，就更难落实责任。
analysis: it 是形式主语，真正主语是 to maintain accountability。If 从句给出条件，when 从句说明追责会发生的情境。

parts: adv::Although the project involves several departments, ||subj::one manager||pred:: remains accountable for ensuring that the work is completed on time.
translation: 虽然项目涉及几个部门，仍有一名经理须负责确保工作按时完成。
analysis: 主干是 one manager remains accountable；for 后接 ensuring，that 从句又是 ensuring 的宾语。责任涉及确保完成，而非声称已完成。

parts: adv::After completing a degree in accountancy, ||subj::she||pred:: joined a small firm where she could learn how businesses actually operated.
translation: 完成会计学学位后，她加入了一家小公司，在那里了解企业实际如何运作。
analysis: After 后接动名词，动作主体与 she 一致；where 从句修饰 firm。how 从句是 learn 的宾语，说明学到的内容。

parts: adv::Before the annual report was released, ||subj::the accountant||pred:: checked whether every payment could be traced to an original receipt.
translation: 年度报告发布前，会计检查了每笔付款能否追溯到原始收据。
analysis: whether 从句是 checked 的宾语；could be traced to 表能够追溯到。accountant 是核账的人，不是账目本身。

parts: adv::Because the charity depended on public donations, ||subj::its accounting records||pred:: were made available to anyone who wanted to see how the money was used.
translation: 由于该慈善机构依靠公众捐款，其会计记录向所有想了解款项用途的人开放。
analysis: 主干是 its accounting records were made available，available 补充说明记录被置于何种状态。who 从句修饰 anyone，内部 how 从句作 see 的宾语。

parts: adv::If small repair jobs are repeatedly postponed, ||subj::problems||pred:: can accumulate until the entire system becomes expensive to maintain.
translation: 如果小修小补一再推迟，问题就会越积越多，直到整个系统的维护费用变得高昂。
analysis: If 从句是被动语态；主句 problems can accumulate 中 accumulate 不接宾语。until 从句说明积累最终达到的状态。

parts: adv::After weeks of heavy snow, ||subj::an accumulation of ice on the roof||pred:: forced the school to close until engineers could inspect the building.
translation: 数周大雪之后，屋顶积冰迫使学校关闭，等待工程师检查建筑。
analysis: 完整主语是 an accumulation of ice on the roof，核心名词 accumulation 为单数。forced the school to close 表示导致学校关闭。

parts: adv::Although each individual delay seemed minor, ||subj::the accumulative effect of repeated interruptions||pred:: prevented the team from finishing the task that day.
translation: 虽然每次耽搁看起来都不严重，反复中断的累积影响却使团队当天无法完成任务。
analysis: 主语核心是 effect；of repeated interruptions 补充影响的来源。prevented the team from finishing 是阻止某人做某事的结构。

parts: adv::Before relying on the information, ||subj::readers||pred:: should consider how its accuracy was checked and whether the method is explained.
translation: 依赖这些信息之前，读者应考虑准确性经过了怎样的核查，以及核查方法是否说明。
analysis: consider 后并列两个宾语从句，由 how 和 whether 引导。its 指 information；accuracy 是被核查的性质。

parts: adv::Even if a prediction is accurate on average, ||subj::it||pred:: may still be unreliable for people whose circumstances differ from those in the data.
translation: 即使某项预测总体上准确，它对那些情况与数据所代表的人不同的人来说仍可能不可靠。
analysis: Even if 引出让步条件；whose circumstances 表示这些人的情况。those 指代前面的 circumstances，避免重复。

parts: adv::When the accusation became public, ||subj::the organisation||pred:: released the documents that it said would clarify what had happened.
translation: 指控公开后，该组织公布了据其称能够说明事件经过的文件。
analysis: 主干是 the organisation released the documents。that 引导定语从句，it said 是嵌入其中的转述，what had happened 表所发生的事情。

parts: adv::Although residents accused the factory of polluting the river, ||subj::the council||pred:: waited for the test results before deciding what action to take.
translation: 虽然居民指责工厂污染河流，地方议会仍等待检测结果，再决定采取什么措施。
analysis: accused the factory of polluting 展示 accuse sb. of doing。what action to take 是疑问词加不定式，作 deciding 的宾语。

parts: adv::To accustom herself to the new timetable, ||subj::she||pred:: began waking up earlier a week before the course started.
translation: 为了让自己适应新的时间安排，她在课程开始前一周就开始早起。
analysis: 句首不定式表示目的；herself 与主语 she 指同一人。before 从句修饰时间，accustom oneself to 后接名词短语 timetable。

parts: adv::Although he was accustomed to working alone, ||subj::he||pred:: soon discovered that discussing early ideas with others could save time.
translation: 尽管他习惯独自工作，他很快发现，及早与他人讨论想法能节约时间。
analysis: accustomed to 后的 to 是介词，故接 working。discovered 的 that 从句中，主语是 discussing early ideas with others 这一动名词短语。

parts: adv::When the match reached its final point, ||subj::the young player||pred:: served an ace that left her opponent with no chance to return the ball.
translation: 比赛来到最后一分时，这位年轻选手发出一记直接得分球，让对手毫无回球机会。
analysis: 主干是 the young player served an ace；that 从句修饰 ace。to return the ball 修饰 chance，说明是哪种机会。

parts: adv::Although her legs ached after the climb, ||subj::she||pred:: felt that the view from the summit had made the effort worthwhile.
translation: 尽管爬山后双腿酸痛，她仍觉得山顶的风景让这番努力很值得。
analysis: 主句 felt 后接 that 宾语从句；从句中 made the effort worthwhile 是宾语加补足语结构。ached 是 ache 的过去式。

parts: adv::If the city is to achieve its goal of cleaner air, ||subj::it||pred:: will need to improve public transport as well as limit traffic.
translation: 如果这座城市要实现空气更清洁的目标，就需要在限制交通的同时改善公共交通。
analysis: is to achieve 表示要实现；主句 need 后接 to improve。as well as limit traffic 与 improve public transport 并列，说明两方面措施。

parts: adv::Although winning the prize was a remarkable achievement, ||subj::she||pred:: valued the friendships that had developed during the project even more.
translation: 虽然获奖是一项非凡成就，她更珍视项目期间建立的友谊。
analysis: Although 从句以 winning the prize 作主语；主句是 she valued the friendships。that 从句修饰 friendships，even more 表示更加重视。

parts: adv::Before the acid was added to the sample, ||subj::the students||pred:: put on the protective equipment their teacher had provided.
translation: 把酸加入样品之前，学生穿戴好了教师提供的防护用品。
analysis: Before 从句使用被动语态；主干是 students put on the protective equipment。their teacher had provided 修饰 equipment，省略了关系代词。

parts: adv::Because the acidity of the soil varied across the field, ||subj::the researchers||pred:: collected samples from several locations rather than relying on a single measurement.
translation: 由于田间各处土壤酸度不同，研究人员从多个地点采样，没有只依赖一次测量。
analysis: Because 从句主语核心是 acidity；主干是 researchers collected samples。rather than 后的 relying 与前述采样方法作对照。

parts: adv::Although the company was slow to acknowledge the problem, ||subj::it||pred:: eventually published an explanation of how the error had occurred.
translation: 虽然公司迟迟没有承认问题，它最终还是公布了错误发生经过的说明。
analysis: be slow to do 表示迟迟才做；主句 it 指 company。how 从句接在 explanation of 后，说明解释内容。

parts: adv::After sending the application, ||subj::she||pred:: waited for an acknowledgement confirming that the documents had reached the correct office.
translation: 寄出申请后，她等待回执，以确认文件已送达正确的办公室。
analysis: confirming 是现在分词，修饰 acknowledgement；that 从句是 confirming 的宾语。acknowledgement 在这里指确认收到的通知。

parts: adv::Before volunteers began their first shift, ||subj::the coordinator||pred:: held a short meeting to acquaint them with the centre's procedures.
translation: 志愿者开始第一次轮班前，协调员开了一个短会，让他们了解中心的办事流程。
analysis: 主干是 coordinator held a short meeting；to acquaint 表目的，them 指 volunteers。acquaint sb. with 是使某人熟悉某事。

parts: adv::Through an acquaintance who worked at the museum, ||subj::we||pred:: learned about a collection that was rarely shown to the public.
translation: 通过一位在博物馆工作的熟人，我们了解到一批很少对公众展出的藏品。
analysis: 句首 Through 短语说明获知渠道，其中 who 修饰 acquaintance。that 从句修饰 collection，was shown 为被动语态。

parts: adv::When learners have opportunities to use the language outside class, ||subj::they||pred:: often acquire expressions that are difficult to remember from a list alone.
translation: 学习者有机会在课外使用语言时，常能学会一些仅靠词表很难记住的表达。
analysis: 主干是 they often acquire expressions；that 从句修饰 expressions，to remember 的逻辑宾语也是 expressions。acquire 在这里指习得。

parts: adv::Although vocabulary acquisition takes time, ||subj::regular contact with useful expressions||pred:: can make new words easier to recognise when they appear again.
translation: 虽然词汇习得需要时间，经常接触有用的表达会让新词再次出现时更容易认出。
analysis: 主句的主语是 regular contact，with 短语补充接触对象。make new words easier to recognise 是使宾语处于某种状态的结构。

parts: adv::When the farm expanded by twenty acres, ||subj::the owners||pred:: set aside part of the new land for trees that would shelter the crops from strong winds.
translation: 农场扩大二十英亩后，主人留出部分新增土地种树，以保护作物免受强风侵袭。
analysis: by twenty acres 表增加的面积；set aside 表留出。that 从句修饰 trees，shelter ... from 表保护……免受……。

parts: adv::Although a footbridge had been built across the river, ||subj::many residents||pred:: continued using the old road because it was closer to their homes.
translation: 虽然河上已建起一座人行桥，许多居民仍走旧路，因为那条路离家更近。
analysis: had been built 是过去完成时的被动语态。across 表横跨河流；because 从句中 it 指 old road，不指 bridge。

parts: adv::While the director was recovering from an operation, ||subj::the acting manager||pred:: made sure that the project continued according to the agreed schedule.
translation: 主任术后恢复期间，代理经理确保项目继续按商定的计划推进。
analysis: While 从句给出一段时间；acting 修饰 manager，表示代理职务。made sure 后接 that 从句，其中 according to 表按照。

parts: adv::Although she had never considered herself an activist, ||subj::she||pred:: began organising meetings after the local library was threatened with closure.
translation: 虽然她从未把自己看作活动人士，当本地图书馆面临关闭时，她开始组织集会。
analysis: considered herself an activist 是宾语加补足语结构；after 从句说明行动的触发事件。be threatened with closure 指面临关闭风险。

parts: adv::After the actress read the letters on which the play was based, ||subj::she||pred:: changed the way she portrayed the main character.
translation: 读完这部戏所依据的书信后，这位女演员改变了塑造主角的方式。
analysis: on which 引导定语从句，介词来自 be based on。主干是 she changed the way；she portrayed ... 说明怎样塑造角色。

parts: adv::Although the estimate seemed reasonable, ||subj::the actual cost of repairing the roof||pred:: was much higher because hidden damage was discovered.
translation: 虽然估价看起来合理，维修屋顶的实际费用却高得多，因为发现了隐藏的损坏。
analysis: 主语核心是 cost，of repairing the roof 说明什么费用。actual 与 estimate 形成实际和估计的对照；because 解释超支原因。

parts: adv::When the team looked closely at how people actually used the app, ||subj::they||pred:: found that a feature they had considered essential was rarely opened.
translation: 团队仔细研究人们实际如何使用这个应用后，发现一项原本被他们视为必需的功能很少有人打开。
analysis: When 从句含 how 宾语从句；主句 found 后的 that 从句中，they had considered essential 修饰 feature。actually 强调实际使用情况。

parts: adv::Because the village faced an acute shortage of teachers, ||subj::some children||pred:: had to travel to a school that was more than an hour away.
translation: 由于村子严重缺乏教师，一些孩子不得不去一所路程超过一小时的学校上学。
analysis: acute 修饰 shortage，表示程度严重。主干是 some children had to travel；that 从句修饰 school，说明距离造成的困难。

parts: adv::Before responding to an ad that promises unusually high pay, ||subj::applicants||pred:: should check whether the employer can be independently verified.
translation: 回应承诺异常高薪的广告之前，申请人应核实雇主是否可通过独立渠道确认。
analysis: that 从句修饰 ad；Before 后的 responding 与主语 applicants 对应。whether 从句是 check 的宾语，can be verified 为被动语态。

parts: adv::Although the equipment was designed for indoor use, ||subj::the team||pred:: managed to adapt it to the conditions they encountered outdoors.
translation: 虽然设备原本为室内使用而设计，团队仍设法使它适应了室外遇到的条件。
analysis: 主干是 the team managed to adapt it；it 指 equipment。they encountered outdoors 修饰 conditions，adapt ... to 表使……适应……。

parts: adv::While the novel tells the story through private letters, ||subj::the film adaptation||pred:: relies on conversations that reveal the characters' thoughts indirectly.
translation: 小说通过私人书信讲述故事，电影改编版则依靠对话间接展现人物的想法。
analysis: While 表示表现方式的对照；主干是 film adaptation relies on conversations。that 从句修饰 conversations，说明对话起的作用。

parts: adv::Because the system uses adaptive controls, ||subj::it||pred:: can respond to changing conditions without requiring an operator to reset every value.
translation: 由于系统采用自适应控制，它能应对变化的条件，无须操作人员重新设定每个数值。
analysis: 主干是 it can respond；without 后接 requiring，requiring 又接 an operator to reset。adaptive 描述控制能够随条件改变。

parts: adv::If the soup tastes too salty, ||subj::you||pred:: can add more water before deciding whether it needs any further seasoning.
translation: 如果汤尝起来太咸，你可以先多加点水，再决定是否需要继续调味。
analysis: If 从句中 tastes 是系动词；before 后接 deciding，whether 从句是 deciding 的宾语。add 的宾语是 more water。

parts: adv::Although he called himself a coffee addict as a joke, ||subj::he||pred:: began to wonder whether the habit was affecting his sleep.
translation: 虽然他只是开玩笑地自称咖啡迷，他开始怀疑这个习惯是否影响了睡眠。
analysis: called himself a coffee addict 为宾语加补足语；whether 从句作 wonder 的宾语。as a joke 限定了 addict 在这里的轻松语气。

parts: adv::When support for addiction is difficult to obtain, ||subj::people who want help||pred:: may struggle to find a service they can afford.
translation: 难以获得成瘾问题的支持服务时，想求助的人可能很难找到负担得起的服务。
analysis: 主语是 people，who want help 修饰它；they can afford 是省略关系代词的定语从句，修饰 service。addiction 是服务针对的问题。

parts: adv::Although the app was marketed as a way to relax, ||subj::some users||pred:: found its endless stream of short videos so addictive that they spent hours watching.
translation: 虽然这个应用被宣传为放松工具，一些用户却觉得接连不断的短视频如此让人停不下来，以至于一看就是几个小时。
analysis: 主句 found 后接宾语 stream 和补足语 addictive。so ... that 表示程度及结果；watching 接在 spent hours 后说明时间用途。

parts: adv::In addition to providing free meals, ||subj::the centre||pred:: offers a quiet space where people can get advice about housing.
translation: 除了提供免费餐食，这个中心还提供一处安静空间，供人们咨询住房问题。
analysis: In addition to 后接 providing，to 为介词；where 从句修饰 space。句子并列说明中心的两项服务。

parts: adv::Because the initial results were uncertain, ||subj::the researchers||pred:: collected additional samples before deciding whether the pattern was meaningful.
translation: 初步结果不确定，因此研究人员又采集了一些样本，再判断观察到的规律是否有意义。
analysis: additional 修饰 samples，表示在已有样本之外增加。whether 从句是 deciding 的宾语；before 说明采样先于判断。

parts: adv::Unless the policy can address the reasons people avoid public transport, ||subj::a reduction in ticket prices alone||pred:: may have little effect.
translation: 如果政策无法处理人们不愿乘坐公共交通的原因，仅降低票价可能收效甚微。
analysis: Unless 从句中的 people avoid public transport 修饰 reasons，省略 why。主语核心是 reduction；address 表处理问题，未承诺已经解决。

parts: adv::After the number of visitors rose sharply, ||subj::the council||pred:: reviewed the adequacy of facilities that had been designed for a much smaller population.
translation: 游客人数大幅增加后，地方议会审查了原本按小得多的人口规模设计的设施是否够用。
analysis: 主干是 council reviewed the adequacy；of facilities 说明核查对象。that 从句修饰 facilities，had been designed 表更早设计的状态。

parts: adv::Although the room was small, ||subj::it||pred:: provided adequate space for students who needed a quiet place to work.
translation: 虽然房间不大，它仍为需要安静学习地点的学生提供了足够空间。
analysis: Although 说明小并未妨碍够用；who 从句修饰 students。adequate 只承诺空间满足需要，不表示空间宽敞。

parts: adv::If workers are not adequately trained before the system is introduced, ||subj::they||pred:: may make mistakes that better preparation could have prevented.
translation: 如果系统启用之前工作人员未得到充分培训，他们可能会犯下一些本可通过更充分准备避免的错误。
analysis: adequately 修饰 trained；If 从句内还有 before 时间从句。that 从句修饰 mistakes，could have prevented 表示原本能够避免。

parts: adv::When an adjective appears after a linking verb, ||subj::it||pred:: still describes the subject even though it does not stand directly before a noun.
translation: 形容词出现在系动词之后时，虽然它没有直接位于名词前，仍然是在描述主语。
analysis: it 指 adjective；even though 引出位置上的让步情况。after a linking verb 说明形容词作表语的常见位置。

parts: adv::As the light outside changed, ||subj::the photographer||pred:: had to adjust the camera settings to keep the pictures clear.
translation: 随着外界光线变化，摄影师不得不调整相机设置，以保持照片清晰。
analysis: As 表示随条件变化；主干是 photographer had to adjust settings。to keep 表目的，keep the pictures clear 中 clear 为补足语。

parts: adv::Although the machine appeared to be broken, ||subj::a small adjustment to the belt||pred:: was enough to get it working again.
translation: 虽然机器看起来坏了，对皮带稍作调整就足以让它重新运转。
analysis: 主语核心是 adjustment，to the belt 说明调整对象。get it working 中 working 是宾语补足语，表示进入运转状态。

parts: adv::Before volunteers were allowed to administer the test, ||subj::they||pred:: received training on how to give instructions without influencing the answers.
translation: 志愿者获准实施测试之前，接受了如何说明要求而不影响答案的培训。
analysis: were allowed to administer 是被允许做某事；on 后接 how to give 结构，说明培训内容。administer the test 在这里指组织施测。

parts: adv::Because several colleges shared the funding, ||subj::a central office||pred:: was created to administrate the scheme and keep the selection process consistent.
translation: 因为几个学院共同使用这笔资金，学校设立了一个中央办公室，负责管理计划并保持选拔流程一致。
analysis: 主干是 a central office was created；to administrate 与 keep 并列说明设立目的。本句保留较少用的考纲词 administrate。

parts: adv::Although most students rarely meet the people working in administration, ||subj::their daily routines||pred:: depend on decisions made in those offices.
translation: 虽然大多数学生很少见到行政部门的工作人员，他们每天的安排却依赖这些办公室作出的决定。
analysis: working in administration 修饰 people；made in those offices 修饰 decisions。their 指 students，administration 指行政管理部门。

parts: adv::By reducing the number of forms that teachers must complete, ||subj::the school||pred:: hopes to cut administrative work without losing useful information.
translation: 学校希望减少教师必须填写的表格数量，在保留有用信息的同时减轻行政工作。
analysis: By 短语说明手段，that 从句修饰 forms；主句 hopes to cut。without losing 说明希望同时满足的限制条件。

parts: adv::Although the attempt did not succeed, ||subj::the team's willingness to share what it had learned||pred:: was admirable.
translation: 虽然尝试没有成功，团队愿意分享所学所得的态度仍值得钦佩。
analysis: 主语核心是 willingness，to share 修饰它；what it had learned 作 share 的宾语。admirable 作表语，评价的是愿意分享的态度。

parts: adv::After seeing how patiently the nurse listened, ||subj::the students||pred:: expressed admiration for a skill that their textbooks had barely discussed.
translation: 看到护士多么耐心地倾听后，学生对这一教科书中几乎未作讨论的能力表达了钦佩。
analysis: how 从句作 seeing 的宾语；主干是 students expressed admiration。for 接钦佩对象 skill，that 从句进一步限定这一技能。

parts: adv::While people often admire visible achievements, ||subj::the quiet work that makes those achievements possible||pred:: may receive little attention.
translation: 人们常常钦佩看得见的成就，让这些成就成为可能的默默付出却可能鲜少受到关注。
analysis: While 连接对照，主句主语核心是 work；that 从句修饰 work，makes achievements possible 为使役结构。

parts: adv::Although admission to the museum was free, ||subj::families||pred:: still had to consider the cost of travelling there and spending a day away from work.
translation: 虽然博物馆免收门票，家庭仍需考虑往返交通和请假一天的成本。
analysis: 主干是 families still had to consider the cost。travelling 与 spending 并列作 of 的宾语；admission 在这里指入场费或入场许可。

parts: adv::When the evidence became impossible to ignore, ||subj::the company||pred:: had to admit that its earlier explanation had been incomplete.
translation: 当证据已不容忽视时，公司不得不承认先前的解释并不完整。
analysis: 主句 admit 后接 that 宾语从句；had been incomplete 表示先前解释的状态早于承认这一动作。admit 此处为承认。

parts: adv::Because the equipment was easily damaged, ||subj::the laboratory||pred:: restricted admittance to people who had completed the required training.
translation: 由于设备容易损坏，实验室仅准许完成规定培训的人进入。
analysis: restricted admittance to 表把准入对象限制为某类人；who 从句修饰 people。admittance 强调实际场所的进入许可。

parts: adv::Admittedly, ||subj::the plan||pred:: would take longer to carry out, but it would give residents more time to prepare for the changes.
translation: 诚然，这项计划实施起来会更久，但它能让居民有更多时间为变化做准备。
analysis: Admittedly 是句子副词，先承认实施较慢；but 连接另一项判断，第二个 it 指 plan。to prepare 说明 more time 的用途。
